annotations.grafana.app/message: Installed by the Grafana Asserts Plugin

spec.description: Dashboard for JVM metrics with Prometheus / OpenTelemetry instrumentation

panels.title: Average CPU load of the whole system for the last minute

targets.expr:
sum(process_runtime_jvm_memory_usage{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env", asserts_site=~"$site", job="$job",service="$service", service!="",type="heap"})

sum(process_runtime_jvm_memory_usage{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env", asserts_site=~"$site", job="$job",service="",type="heap"})

sum(process_runtime_jvm_memory_committed{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env", asserts_site=~"$site", job="$job",service="$service", service!="",type="heap"})
or
sum(process_runtime_jvm_memory_committed{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env", asserts_site=~"$site", job="$job",service="",type="heap"})

sum(process_runtime_jvm_memory_limit{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env", asserts_site=~"$site", job="$job",service="$service", service!="",type="heap"})
or
sum(process_runtime_jvm_memory_limit{namespace=~"$namespace",asserts_env=~"$env", asserts_site=~"$site", job="$job",service="",type="heap"})
